findings.finding: A client interruption between the accepted migration's separate PostgreSQL DDL statements could leave an unfinished Prisma row plus partial outbox objects, but database-status rejected the unfinished row before the durable recovery path could reconcile it.
findings.required_remediation: Recognize only one exact unfinished target migration, clean only its fixed additive footprint when empty and dependency-free, mark that exact failed migration rolled back through a fixed named Prisma resolve runner, prove the pending baseline, then retry through the existing fixed migration runner.

findings.finding: Application health accepted any HTTP status from 200 through 499 and ignored the JSON body even though the route returns HTTP 200 for body status degraded or error.
findings.required_remediation: Require HTTP 200, bounded valid JSON and exact body status ok before release acceptance.
